title: The plan says it adds three CLI flags, but specifies four
text: The plan says it adds three CLI flags, but specifies four: --sweep-mode, --runs, --output-file, and --version-attestation. Correct the count.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 472dd21, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
